 'A black truth is that you...': AICWA's message after Shah Rukh Khan's Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor made a heartfelt appeal for work
 SECTIONS 'A black truth is that you...': AICWA's message after Shah Rukh Khan's Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor made a heartfelt appeal for work By ET Entertainment Desk , Last Updated: Nov 14, 2026, 04:49:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Shah Rukh Khan's Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor has appealed to CINTAA for work as he recovers from a football injury. AICWA president Suresh Shyamla Gupta urged Bollywood filmmakers and celebrities to support him, highlighting the industry's uncertain job opportunities. Sharad currently uses a walker but hopes to recover fully and resume professional commitments in January 2027.
 Sharad Kapoor seeks work as he recovers from a leg injury, prompting AICWA to urge Bollywood to support the actor. (Agencies)
 Actor Sharad Kapoor who has been a part of the film industry for a long time has shared the screen with Shah Rukh Khan in Josh. Recently, the actor went viral after his health challenges came to light and had to let go of his pet dogs to care centre. Amid this, he made a video appealing to Cine And TV Artistes' Association (CINTAA) to help him with job opportunities . Now, All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) stepped forward to support him. AICWA president, Suresh Shyamla Gupta, has urged Bollywood filmmakers and celebrities to help the actor get work.
 AICWA president makes emotional appeal for Sharad Kapoor
Suresh Shyamla Gupta, president of the All Indian Cine Workers Association, shared a video urging prominent filmmakers and celebrities to support Sharad. “He is only 50 years old. Today he needs us. And a black truth is that you will get one job in the industry today and another job after 10 days or after 1 year or after 2 years or not. This is the biggest black truth,” he said. 
He pointed out the lack of regular work in the entertainment industry and uncertainties and hence, he urged everyone to help Sharad Kapoor. "This is what is going on in our industry today. So today we have to stand with him,” he added.
 Sharad Kapoor's appeal to CINTAA 
The appeal comes after a video of Sharad handing over his four beloved dogs to an NGO for care surfaced online because his health condition made it difficult for him to look after them. Actor Jaya Bhattacharya visited him after the video went viral and shared a clip on Instagram in which Sharad appealed to CINTAA for work. “I want to appeal to CINTAA that I am looking for good work. And I need your support,” he said, adding, “A little bit of moral support is also enough for me. I am a great actor and you know that. Money is not the issue. The only issue is I am just looking forward to start work again.”
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jayaa Bhatacharrya (@jaya.bhattacharya) 
 Sharad Kapoor reveals how he injured his leg
Speaking about his injury, Sharad revealed that it happened while he was playing football in Barcelona. He injured his leg while playing football in all enthusiasm. The injury affected his mobility, and he currently relies on a walker.
 For the unversed, Sharad has appeared in films including Josh, Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta, Jaani Dushman: Ek Anokhi Kahani, LOC Kargil and Lakshya to name a few.
